findings.current: A Great Hero of the orthodox faction, renowned for his fairness and integrity, had a habit of raping women. A master of an unorthodox faction had wiped out an entire village for fun.
findings.defect: The translation omits the killing in 간살, changing the Great Hero's established crime from rape and murder to rape alone.
findings.rationale: 간살 means to rape and kill; both actions are part of the contrast demonstrating that Mungyeong's victims deserved death.
findings.replacement: A Great Hero of the orthodox faction, renowned for his fairness and integrity, had a habit of raping and murdering women. A master of an unorthodox faction had wiped out an entire village for fun.
findings.source: 공명정대함으로 이름 높은 정파의 대협은 여인을 간살하는 취미가 있었고, 어느 사파의 고수는 재미 삼아 촌락 하나를 몰살시켰다.

findings.current: “The Hour of the Dog.[^2] You said we would depart from the western harbor of Chengdu.”
findings.defect: The draft inserts “you” as the speaker who supplied the departure information, making Mungyeong responsible for a statement the source leaves unattributed.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject does not support addressing Mungyeong as the person who set or announced the departure; the later exchange identifies Taekyung as the one who mentioned the Hour of the Dog.
findings.replacement: “The Hour of the Dog.[^2] They said the ship would depart from Chengdu’s western harbor.”
findings.source: “술시(戌時). 성도의 서쪽 항구에서 출발한다고 했습니다.”

findings.current: Not only martial artists, but also fearless ordinary citizens had come to see us off. The crowd stretched endlessly, one person after another, until it was impossible to count them.
findings.defect: The first-person “us” prematurely shifts the opening's external third-person viewpoint to Taekyung's narration.
findings.rationale: The source describes the departing pair and the crowd externally; first-person narration does not begin until the later harbor scene.
findings.replacement: Not only martial artists, but also fearless ordinary citizens had come to see them off. The crowd stretched endlessly, one person after another, until it was impossible to count them.
findings.source: 비단 무림인뿐만 아니라 겁 없는 양민들까지 더해지니, 배웅에 나선 인파는 꼬리에 꼬리를 물고 늘어져 셀 수가 없었다.

findings.current: And on a hill that no one was looking toward, a boy sitting on a tree stump watched the whole scene before suddenly opening his mouth.
findings.defect: “No one was looking toward” changes an unvisited, secluded hill into a hill merely outside the crowd's line of sight, and “opening his mouth” is an unnatural literalism for speaking.
findings.rationale: 아무도 찾지 않는 describes a place no one visits or seeks out, while 입을 열었다 naturally means that he spoke.
findings.replacement: On a deserted hill, a boy sat on a tree stump watching the entire scene. Then he suddenly spoke.
findings.source: 그리고 아무도 찾지 않는 언덕 위, 나무 그루터기에 앉아 모든 광경을 지켜보고 있던 소년이 문득 입을 열었다.

findings.current: “If I had not fought the Demonic Cult, the entire world would have pointed fingers at me. Just as it had until then.”
findings.defect: “Until then” incorrectly moves the temporal endpoint into the past rather than extending it through the present.
findings.rationale: 지금껏 means “until now” or “all this time,” not “until then.”
findings.replacement: “If I had not fought the Demonic Cult, the entire world would have pointed fingers at me. Just as it always had.”
findings.source: “내가 마교와 싸우지 않았다면, 온 천하가 나를 손가락질했을 것이다. 지금껏 그래 왔던 것처럼.”

findings.defect: The draft changes a request for the current time into a question about whether the departure time has arrived.
findings.rationale: 지금 시간이 asks what the present time is; Mu Song's answer then explains that the stated Hour of the Dog has already passed.

findings.current: The man changing forms of address as quickly as beans roasted by lightning was Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song. I offered him a solution.
findings.defect: The literal rendering “beans roasted by lightning” is opaque and unnatural in English.
findings.rationale: 번개에 콩 볶듯 is an idiom for doing something extremely quickly; the replacement preserves the speed-based joke without an incomprehensible calque.
findings.replacement: The man cycling through forms of address at lightning speed was Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song. I offered him a solution.
findings.source: 나는 번개에 콩 볶듯 호칭을 바꿔 대는 선화아(船火兒) 무송에게 해결책을 제시해 주었다.

summary: Two scene facts are altered, and several localized viewpoint, temporal, and wording issues remain.
